description: Memory Interface levels. Each names the Nexus conformance level it runs on (Spec §89) and the optional capabilities it adds (Spec §67.4). Durable workers and Capsule exchange are capabilities a binding advertises beside its levels (durable_brain_runtime, receiver_fencing, capsule_export, capsule_import), not levels. Existing Schema symbol identities are unchanged.

memory_basic.notes: Runs on a KIP-Core Nexus with the standard memory package activated: prefers, Commitment and Watch are its symbols, without requiring the dependency-validity and computed-strength engine features of KIP-CognitiveMemory. Dependency validity (Spec §57.6) binds every derived artifact the Brain writes; a Brain that writes none needs no DependencyBasis. Payload-only forgetting uses PURGE PAYLOAD, which KIP-Core already requires. Channels of unadvertised levels still require an authoritative scoped absence or irrelevance determination before not_applicable; retained relevant content that cannot be served makes coverage incomplete.
